traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Salvadoraceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; stipules usually absent, often present; plants hermaphrodite, dioecious or polygamous; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit berry or drupe; parts of each whorl 4; stamens 4 (-5); carpels 2.
